propositions: A configured provider is silently discarded when a model ID contains a colon, particularly for canonical Bedrock versioned IDs in the form 'anthropic.claude-X-vN:M'

The _resolve_target function's 'already provider-qualified' test checks `if ':' in model` but this returns true for Bedrock version suffixes, not provider prefixes, causing configured providers to be lost

Two independent implementations of the same qualification decision (in _resolve_target and infer_provider) diverged and both failed identically, resulting in fragments of model IDs being reported as unknown providers
Guard order was wrong: model string qualification was tested before checking explicitly configured providers, allowing punctuation in a model ID to override explicit configuration
Unversioned Bedrock aliases without colons happened to work, hiding the bug for the majority form of canonical versioned IDs that AWS publishes
